items.prompt: Given d1=-7.9 and positive width sigma*sqrt(T)=0.2, what does d2 show about the public d1-only bound?

options.text: d2=-8.1, outside the extra d2 bound.
options.why: The promise abs(d1)<8 does not imply the same bound for d2=d1-width.

options.text: d2=-7.7, because the width is added.
options.why: The formula subtracts positive width from d1.

options.text: d2 must equal d1 for every volatility.
options.why: The difference is sigma*sqrt(T), positive in the stated domain.

options.text: The public input must have zero volatility.
options.why: The positive width is compatible with the positive-volatility domain.
